items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Constant and Marlon. Played there every Friday night for about three years.

ctx.x: You know, at that gym up there. Constant and Marlon. Played there every Friday night for about three years. Mm-hmm. About three years, every Friday, played there, all holidays that we could take. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
